args.sql:
WITH airports AS (
    SELECT 
        airport_code, 
        json_extract_string(city, '$.en') as city_en,
        CAST(string_split(trim(coordinates, '()'), ',')[1] AS DOUBLE) * pi() / 180 as lon_rad,
        CAST(string_split(trim(coordinates, '()'), ',')[2] AS DOUBLE) * pi() / 180 as lat_rad
    FROM airlines.main.airports_data
),
routes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        f.departure_airport,
        f.arrival_airport,
        a1.city_en as dep_city,
        a2.city_en as arr_city,
        a1.lat_rad as lat1,
        a1.lon_rad as lon1,
        a2.lat_rad as lat2,
        a2.lon_rad as lon2
    FROM airlines.main.flights f
    JOIN airports a1 ON f.departure_airport = a1.airport_code
    JOIN airports a2 ON f.arrival_airport = a2.airport_code
    WHERE a1.city_en = 'Abakan' OR a2.city_en = 'Abakan'
)
SELECT 
    dep_city,
    arr_city,
    2 * 6371 * ASIN(SQRT(
        POWER(SIN((lat2 - lat1) / 2), 2) + 
        COS(lat1) * COS(lat2) * POWER(SIN((lon2 - lon1) / 2), 2)
    )) as distance_km
FROM routes
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH routes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        f.departure_airport,
        f.arrival_airport,
        json_extract_string(a1.city, '$.en') as dep_city,
        json_extract_string(a2.city, '$.en') as arr_city,
        CAST(regexp_extract(a1.coordinates, '\(([^,]+),', 1) AS DOUBLE) * pi() / 180 as lon1,
        CAST(regexp_extract(a1.coordinates, ',([^)]+)\)', 1) AS DOUBLE) * pi() / 180 as lat1,
        CAST(regexp_extract(a2.coordinates, '\(([^,]+),', 1) AS DOUBLE) * pi() / 180 as lon2,
        CAST(regexp_extract(a2.coordinates, ',([^)]+)\)', 1) AS DOUBLE) * pi() / 180 as lat2
    FROM airlines.main.flights f
    JOIN airlines.main.airports_data a1 ON f.departure_airport = a1.airport_code
    JOIN airlines.main.airports_data a2 ON f.arrival_airport = a2.airport_code
    WHERE a1.city LIKE '%Abakan%' OR a2.city LIKE '%Abakan%'
)
SELECT 
    dep_city,
    arr_city,
    2 * 6371 * ASIN(LEAST(1.0, SQRT(
        POWER(SIN((lat2 - lat1) / 2), 2) + 
        COS(lat1) * COS(lat2) * POWER(SIN((lon2 - lon1) / 2), 2)
    ))) as distance_km
FROM routes
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
